document.title: PP 9/2026: THR dan gaji ketiga belas ASN dan pensiunan 2026

delta.note: This government regulation sets the 2026 holiday allowance (THR) and 13th salary for state apparatus (civil servants, PPPK, military, police, state officials), pensioners and benefit recipients. Its subjects are civil servants, pensioners and other government personnel, not private-sector permanent employees. The tax provision only states that PPh is borne by the government under existing rules; it does not change any PPh 21 rate, table, threshold, deduction or calculation step for pegawai tetap.
